thread:
anna: Quick follow-up from ACME on-prem outage postmortem. Need clear owners/timelines for: VPC peering remediation, on-prem adapter concurrency bug, isolation runbook updates. I'll start a tracker. Who can take which?

matt: I can own VPC peering remediation. Will put together steps and a rollback plan. Target: EOD Fri. Creating ENG-2245.

sara: I'll take the on-prem adapter bug (max-conn leak). Can reproduce locally, root cause looks like connection pool not expiring. ETA: next Wed for PR, then deploy Thu. Ticket INF-452.

josh: I'll update the isolation runbook and add a checklist for affected customers + runbooks for peering re-establish. Need someone to sign off on playbook. Ping @maria for SOC review.

maria: Happy to review the SOC / compliance bits. Can we include steps for key rotation and KMS checks? Also need audit log locations.

matt: adding a small verification step after peering re-create: `aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=status-code,Values=active` and `telnet <customer-gateway> 443` — will add to ENG-2245.

sara: Debug snippet that helped repro locally: ```python
# simulate adapter connections
for i in range(500):
  conn = adapter.get()
  conn.close()
# pool size didn't shrink as expected
``` Will add logs and a failing unit test.

alex: Flag: recurring pattern — we saw three prior incidents where peering flaps coincided with adapter overload. Can we link the historical incidents and add a monitoring alert for peering-state changes + adapter queue length? Suggest priority P2.

anna: :thumbsup: Good call. Alex, can you own the alerting work? If so, create a dash + alert rule and list in the tracker.

alex: On it. Creating INF-459 for alerts + dash. ETA Tue.

josh: I'll consolidate all tickets into a single customer-facing remediation timeline doc and post to the ACME workspace monday AM. Also propose a canary: reestablish peering to staging first.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New issue ENG-2245 created by matt. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-2245

anna: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist I'll add to the tracker: owner, ticket, ETA, rollback steps, verification commands, SOC signoff, customer comms deadline. If no objections I'll lock owners by EOD today.

maria: No objections. Will review SOC bits by Thu.

matt: :thumbsup: locking ENG-2245 as owner matt - peering remediation.
